_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The strong retail participation and long-term support suggest upward momentum, aligning with the cautious optimism from the narrative.
next_move.brains_agree: The Pattern Analyst and Narrative Writer both agree on the forward call.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed index crosses 70 with ETF flows above 75
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with BTC funding turning negative
